smooth_finite_energy_gauge_ansatz.qualification: Explicit finite-energy variational configuration; nonzero scalar Euler-Lagrange residual proves it is not a stationary solution of the stated zero-potential energy. Not an E8/G2 vacuum. A_t=tA preserves the Fredholm index.

E6_preserving_SU3_alternative.E8_sector: (27,3); E6 commutes with this Higgs and connection
E6_preserving_SU3_alternative.conjugate_sector_gate: For Abar=A*, Phibar=-Phi*, C=i sigma2 on spatial spinors gives Lbar=-C L* C^-1 (star denotes complex conjugation, not adjoint). The conjugate27bar block has the SAME3D Callias index. Actual4D chirality/Majorana/CPT projection must be derived.
E6_preserving_SU3_alternative.remaining_Dflat_obstacle: The SM singlets Nc:(chi,Psi)=(-5,1) and S:(0,4) both have Psi>0: three27s alone still cannot give a nonzero zero-FI SM-preserving D-flat condensate.
E6_preserving_SU3_alternative.scope: A different auxiliary family-sector Dirac operator, not an index of the full E8 adjoint. Neutral sectors remain ungapped. Three4D chiral27s are NOT established: conjugate block has sameCalliasindex and actual7D Clifford/Majorana/4D chirality assignment is missing. The oldT-negative-localizer antifamily argument no longer applies, but cannot be replaced by an assumed chiral projection.

Callias_nonAbelian_escape.index_scope: Callias theorem gives net index magnitude3 for this explicit auxiliary gapped8-component Dirac operator, not a proof exactly3 modes with no additional pairs. Tensoring a spectator Spin10 spinor gives index modulus48.
Callias_nonAbelian_escape.exclusions: This is a scalar mass endomorphism, not the PW Higgs1-form or the earlier physical massless monopole vacuum. It does not commute with fixed H27 holonomies, select degree3, or settle all E8 sectors. The supplied nonzeroA gives finite energy but explicitly fails the stated zero-potential scalar equation; it is not a Yang-Mills-Higgs/BPS or G2 solution.
Callias_nonAbelian_escape.theorem_reference: Gesztesy-Waurick arXiv:1506.05144, bounded C2 Hermitian mass with exterior gap and derivatives O(1/r),O(1/r^2).
